CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinates with color) is identified, its presentation/access entries are present, and a separate origin/status field differentiates status for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition is linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify represented contents (coordinate sets) with color attributes.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from the coordinate/color content entries, distinguishing identification from status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: Text describes how contents are presented/emerge (peaks, current vs candidate) and lists organized coordinate sets for specific referents.
